name: zvideo_dd_blt_sw_to_primary_rect
description: zVideo_dd::BltSwToPrimaryRect lazily ensures an image DirectDraw surface, builds source and destination rectangles, clips the destination against the primary surface while mirroring source offsets, toggles the primary lock around DirectDraw Blt, and reports Blt failures.
